visualizations.title: Wigner 之友 · 贝尔竞技场
visualizations.title_en: Wigner’s friend in a Bell arena
visualizations.summary: 朋友写下的结果作 CHSH 的一臂，Wigner 撤销朋友之后的相干测量作另一臂。量子比特朋友给出 2√2，超过任何“绝对事实答案表”都达不到的 2；朋友的记录副本越多、撤销越难，违背越小，真人朋友只剩 2。换参考系可以让 Wigner 或 Bob 先测，关联不变；两份结果只在汇合处才成为同一本账上的事实。
visualizations.summary_en: The friend’s written result is one arm of a CHSH test and Wigner’s coherent measurement after undoing the friend is the other. A qubit friend gives 2√2, beyond the 2 that no absolute answer table can exceed; the more copies of the friend’s record and the harder the undo, the smaller the violation, down to 2 for a human friend. Boosting to another frame lets Wigner or Bob measure first without changing the correlations, and the two results become facts in one ledger only where they meet.

visualizations.title: 薛定谔的猫 · 账本时空块
visualizations.title_en: Schrödinger’s cat as a ledger spacetime
visualizations.summary: 400 只盒子里的猫画成一块记录时空：计数器第一次响就是猫的死亡时刻。盒内账本随时写下事实，盒外账本到开箱才读到；改检查频率、衰变方式和暗态会改变历史，改开箱时刻、账本、钟和条件化只是读账，档案一个字节也不变。还可以调记录副本数看相干怎样消失，试一次 Wigner 撤销，并切换到只在写入记录时前进的账本钟。
visualizations.summary_en: Cats in 400 boxes drawn as one block of records: the counter’s first click is a cat’s death time. The inside ledger writes each fact as it happens and the outside ledger reads it only at opening. Changing the check interval, the decay coupling or the dark state changes the history; changing the opening time, the ledger, the clock or the conditioning only reads it, and the archive does not change by a byte. You can also vary the number of record copies to watch coherence vanish, try Wigner’s undo, and switch to a ledger clock that moves only when a record is written.

visualizations.title: 双缝时空体
visualizations.summary: 把双缝与延迟选择擦除的一次运行画成静态时空体。路径记录可以用 2 到 8 个读数的仪器读取，每个读数一个条件时空，它们相加总是同一个总体；还可以切换钟条件化、展开第四轴、交换读取顺序，并对时间做非线性重标。
visualizations.summary_en: One run of the double-slit and delayed-choice eraser drawn as a static spacetime block. The path record can be read by an instrument with 2 to 8 outcomes; each outcome defines a conditional spacetime, and together they always add up to the same whole. You can also switch clock conditioning, unfold a fourth axis, swap the read order and relabel time nonlinearly.
